editor_mode: assistant-authored frozen policy, not independent LLM calls
calibration_selection: All three formats are predeclared. Select highest development accuracy (tie: declared order); only that format is assessed once on calibration. Gate requires >=0.8 on both development and calibration, abstentions count incorrect.
multiple_testing: Layer-cluster bootstrap; two primary comparisons use Bonferroni simultaneous 95% intervals (97.5% marginal intervals). No selection or retuning on final test.
semantic_scope: Exploratory prediction of actual target A/B likelihood from partial static weight evidence, not full-checkpoint understanding.
